responsibility: Defines the RTL operand and operator predicates used by the MMIX machine description to validate comparisons, condition-code registers, addresses, symbolic call targets, constants, small immediates, zero operands, and frame-pointer-related forms. These predicates capture MMIX-specific legality rules that guide pattern matching in mmix.md, especially for comparison lowering, branch formation, call operands, reload-sensitive address checks, and special nonlocal-goto frame references.
